decision.criteria: Pass if the scene's tonal modeling is pervasively conveyed by pencil-like shading, such as directional strokes, hatching, graphite-like rubbed tones or mark-based texture following object form. Reduced saturation, softened contrast and a uniform texture overlay alone do not satisfy this condition. Use unknown only when the visual evidence cannot establish the shading style.
